source: DESIGN_SPEC.md four-distance table + ONE RETURN contract (void-anchor/sleeper/README.md); painting borrowed from /sleeper/borrowed-river/landscape.jpg (sha256 7b1e50ff…); city matter fetched live from /recovery/sleeper/site-source-2026-09-18/docs/ONE_RETURN_V2.md

contract.identity: one hash32: painting sha256 -> tag = city tag = artifact tag (f0f09635)
contract.recomposition: route -> hash32(tag|U/D/L/R witness) -> visited-tile tone inside a measured band + a hairline trace of the walked path
contract.rest: empty route recomposes to the original pixels (mad64 = 0, changedPx = 0)
contract.witness: compressed U/D/L/R string; blocked steps never enter it; returning to the origin coordinate completes the run

changes: Four distances over ONE 96x32 grid derived from the painting: luminance -> cell tone, edges -> walls, hue -> district, texture -> weather density
ENTERED carries text matter from the canonical contract: paragraph = district, sentence = building, word = room, character = material, punctuation = window/rain/lamp/beacon
Touch-first: tap to resolve, press-and-hold to decode a cell, swipe or arrow keys to step, tap RETURN to restore the painting exactly
Deterministic recomposition with in-page measurements (mad64 vs original, changedPx, sha256) shown in the readout
Moiré identity strip from lib/moire-ambient.js identity()/hash32 seeded by painting tag + route seed

validation.selftest: PASS: node sleeper/ladder/ladder-selftest.mjs — 34/34 (synthetic painting) and 34/34 (real landscape pixels, 512x171 dump)
validation.browser: PASS: Chromium 390x844 dpr2 — boot, four distances, touch tap, dwell decode, touch swipe step, keyboard step, EXIT metrics, RETURN to origin, return-to-origin gate
validation.determinism: same witness twice -> identical sha256 (a9e62ac2…); different witness -> different sha256; empty witness -> mad64 0 vs original

limits: NEAR motion runs only during the resolve transition and while a finger is held (P3 forbids ambient auto-play); no continuous drift
The recomposition bakes visited tiles plus the walked trace; it does not re-paint brushwork, so a long straight route reads as a drawn line
One fixed matter source (the canonical ONE RETURN v2 contract); no source picker yet
No Gate circuit and no Return Artifact v2 — this slice is the distance ladder, not the eight-gate world
Determinism is proven on the natural-size pixel buffer; display resampling at other DPRs is outside the contract
